description: Use when someone asks whether or how they can fly a drone in Thailand, e.g. "can I fly my drone in Phuket", "do I need to register my DJI Mini in Thailand", "drone rules Bangkok", "Drohne Thailand Registrierung", "darf ich in Thailand mit der Drohne fliegen", "Drohne mitnehmen Thailand", "drone Thaïlande enregistrement", "puis-je faire voler mon drone en Thaïlande". Returns what a hobby or tourist pilot needs (CAAT and NBTC registration, insurance, flight rules, restricted areas for the place) with public sources, and a link to the DroneClear service information page that fits (DroneClear can handle the registration for you). It gives no prices. It covers hobby, leisure and tourism flights only: if the flight is paid or commercial (filming for a client), set purpose=commercial; the answer then gives only a scope notice and a contact link. If the user has not said whether the flight is for hobby or paid work, ask them first (purpose=unsure returns that question). Thailand only: places in other countries get an out-of-scope answer.

drone_model.description: Drone model, e.g. "DJI Mini 4 Pro". Give this or weight_g.

has_caat_registration.description: True if the pilot already holds a CAAT registration and only needs NBTC.

has_camera.description: Does the drone carry a camera?

language.description: Answer language: en, de, fr (match the user; for any other language use en and translate the answer).

location.description: City or area in Thailand, e.g. "Bangkok", "Phuket".

purpose.description: Why they fly. Use commercial for any paid work, filming for a client or business use; leisure_tourism for holiday and hobby flights; unsure only if the user has not said (the tool then asks them).

weight_g.description: Take-off weight in grams, if known.

name: drone_check

info_url.description: Page on droneclearthailand.com with more on the place or drone model.

scope.description: hobby_check = full answer; commercial_contact_only = the check does not cover paid work, only the contact link is given; needs_input = a question for the user must be answered first (weight, or hobby vs paid work); out_of_scope = place outside Thailand or drone over 25 kg.

title: Thailand drone check
